capacities.description: Safe local antenna positioning and motion.
Local deep-space communication and radar service.
Network-level mission communication coverage through other stations.

facts: The system is a fully steerable 70-meter antenna within an international network of multiple antennas.
The local antenna has azimuth/elevation motion, control, sensing, mechanical, hydraulic, and operational layers.
The wider network can provide some mission coverage through other antennas.
Analysts must separate local intrinsic continuity from network-level compensation.
forbidden_outcome_material: identified software, human, and hydraulic failures
identity_prompt: Distinguish continuity of the local antenna from continuity of the wider communications network.

sources.title: Antennas of the Deep Space Network
